class.name: StandaloneApplication
class.brief_description: An [Application] that self-hosts a single UI node for preview (F6 / Run-As-Standalone).
class.description:
StandaloneApplication encapsulates the host-graph construction shared by [Activity], [Dialog], and [Toast] when they run on their own — e.g. pressing F6 on a single [code]*_activity.tscn[/code] / [code]*_dialog.tscn[/code] in the editor, or [code]godot --path . .tscn[/code].
The static [method host] builds: [codeblock] SceneTree.root └─ StandaloneApplication └─ StandaloneRoot (Control, FULL_RECT) └─ (reparented here) [/codeblock] It wires the managers ([method Application.initialize]) and installs a default [AutoActivityLoader] rooted at [code]res://[/code] so cross-screen navigation works without manual registration.
"Is this node running standalone?" is answered by whether its bound [Application] is a StandaloneApplication ([method Object.is_class] / C++ cast) — there is no per-node boolean flag, because standalone-ness is a property of the hosting Application. See [method Activity.is_standalone] / [method Dialog.is_standalone] / [method Toast.is_standalone].
Users normally never construct this directly; the node's [code]run_standalone_bootstrap[/code] calls [method host] for them.

method.name: get_standalone_root
method.description: Returns the [code]StandaloneRoot[/code] [Control] under which the previewed UI node is parented, or [code]null[/code] before [method host] has run.

method.name: host
method.description: Builds the standalone host environment around [param ui] (which must already be in a [SceneTree]), reparents [param ui] under [code]StandaloneRoot[/code], wires the managers, and installs a default [AutoActivityLoader]. Returns the new StandaloneApplication (already added to the tree), or [code]null[/code] on failure. The caller is responsible for adopting [param ui] into the manager and dispatching its lifecycle.
